name: Angsana Golf Residences Topaz
shortDescription: Angsana Golf Residences Topaz is a branded residential development by Banyan Group Residences inside the Laguna Phuket integrated resort.
description: Angsana Golf Residences Topaz is a branded residential development by Banyan Group Residences inside the Laguna Phuket integrated resort. It consists of three curved low-rise buildings, each divided into two interconnected blocks, with two- and three-bedroom residences and penthouses. The ring-shaped rooftop pool offers views over the golf course, mountains and coast. Owners receive Laguna Golf Phuket membership and RAVA Beach Club access.
facilities: Ground-floor BBQ area in tropical gardens
Direct garden access for ground-floor units
Community: RAVA Beach Club Prestige Zone access
